semantic_evidence.original_quote: Return the share of Huawei's TDocs that led to resolutions (effectiveness rate).
semantic_evidence.finding: The denominator unit is each distinct Huawei Tdoc record; the numerator is the subset of those same documents with at least one typed Resolution citation. The English explicitly says share of Tdocs, so counting Resolution records or reference edges would change units. WITH DISTINCT t removes repeated company-edge witnesses and EXISTS yields one Boolean regardless of repeated citations, shared documents, or several Resolutions.
